_comment: WRONG - Never use logic/operators, and never prefix bindings with `data.`
_note_on_data_prefix: The `data: [...]` block in a Collection cell Layout declares variable names + types. It is NOT a namespace. Bindings always reference the bare name (e.g. `@{titleKey}`, `@{onNavigate}`). Prefixing with `data.` breaks at runtime — the generated code emits direct property access.
_note_on_mixed_text: A value that mixes literal text with a binding composes a string in the layout. The ViewModel composes it (`totalLine`, `fullName`) and the layout binds it as one value: `@{totalLine}`. From jsonui-cli 1.9.6 the build warns [binding-mixed-text].
_note_on_bare_handlers: `"onClick": "onButtonTap"` (no `@{}`) calls nothing on an event declared binding-only; write `@{onButtonTap}`. From jsonui-cli 1.9.6 the build warns (binding-bare-event).
